fundorte.vorkommen.see_beylikova: Beylikova (Eskişehir): rare earths, pilot plant; extent disputed
fundorte.vorkommen.gas_sakarya: Sakarya field (Black Sea, landfall at Filyos)
fundorte.ort.bosporus.name: Bosporus
fundorte.ort.bosporus.warum: The only sea route from the Black Sea to the Mediterranean; the Montreux Convention (1936) gives Turkey oversight of warships.
fundorte.ort.bosporus.wirkung: Leverage over Russia and Ukraine; in war Turkey can deny passage to warships, Black Sea grain exports pass through here.
fundorte.ort.dardanellen.name: Dardanelles
fundorte.ort.dardanellen.warum: The second part of the Straits; with the Bosporus the key to the Black Sea.
fundorte.ort.dardanellen.wirkung: Together with the Bosporus: Montreux as leverage, protection of Turkey's own imports.
fundorte.ort.zypern.name: Cyprus
fundorte.ort.zypern.warum: In the middle of the eastern Mediterranean, gas fields offshore, a divided island with Turkish troops in the north.
fundorte.ort.zypern.wirkung: Whoever dominates Cyprus controls sea lanes and gas fields in the eastern Mediterranean; a lasting dispute with Greece and the EU, an obstacle to accession.
fundorte.ort.suez.name: Suez Canal
fundorte.ort.suez.warum: The shortest sea route between Asia and Europe; a large share of imports from China and the Gulf passes through it.
fundorte.ort.suez.wirkung: A closure makes imports from Asia (electronics, fertiliser) dearer and lengthens delivery times.
fundorte.ort.hormus.name: Strait of Hormuz
fundorte.ort.hormus.warum: Chokepoint for Gulf oil and liquefied gas; Iran can threaten it.
fundorte.ort.hormus.wirkung: If closed, part of the oil and LNG imports drops out and energy prices rise.
fundorte.ort.babalmandab.name: Bab al-Mandab
fundorte.ort.babalmandab.warum: Southern entrance to the Red Sea and thus to the Suez Canal.
fundorte.ort.babalmandab.wirkung: Attacks on ships here act like a partial closure of the Suez Canal.
fundorte.ort.tanap.name: TANAP (gas from Azerbaijan)
fundorte.ort.tanap.warum: Gas from the Caspian through Turkey to Europe; makes Turkey a hub.
fundorte.ort.tanap.wirkung: Secures Azerbaijan's share of gas imports and transit revenue; ties with Azerbaijan and the EU.
fundorte.ort.turkstream.name: TurkStream (gas from Russia)
fundorte.ort.turkstream.warum: The largest single route for Russian gas into Turkey and on to south-eastern Europe.
fundorte.ort.turkstream.wirkung: Dependence on Russia; sanctions or disputes hit supply here first.
fundorte.ort.kirkuk_ceyhan.name: Kirkuk–Ceyhan (oil from Iraq)
fundorte.ort.kirkuk_ceyhan.warum: Oil from northern Iraq to the Mediterranean port of Ceyhan; stopped at times since 2023 because of an arbitration ruling.
fundorte.ort.kirkuk_ceyhan.wirkung: Revenue and influence in northern Iraq; leverage and a bone of contention with Baghdad.
fundorte.ort.btc.name: Baku–Tbilisi–Ceyhan (oil)
fundorte.ort.btc.warum: Caspian oil to the Mediterranean, bypassing Russia and Iran.
fundorte.ort.btc.wirkung: Ties with Azerbaijan and Georgia; Ceyhan as an energy port.
fundorte.ort.incirlik.name: İncirlik Air Base
fundorte.ort.incirlik.warum: Air base used by the United States; a pledge in relations with Washington.
fundorte.ort.incirlik.wirkung: Leverage over the USA: restricting use costs trust, opening it brings support.
fundorte.ort.mersin_hafen.name: Port of Mersin
fundorte.ort.mersin_hafen.warum: The country's largest container port on the Mediterranean; gateway to the Middle East.
fundorte.ort.mersin_hafen.wirkung: A bottleneck here slows exports and imports in the south.
fundorte.ort.ambarli.name: Ambarlı and Marmara ports
fundorte.ort.ambarli.warum: Main cargo handling for Istanbul and the industry of the Marmara region.
fundorte.ort.ambarli.wirkung: A bottleneck here hits industry and retail across the country.
fundorte.ort.ataturk_damm.name: Atatürk Dam (Euphrates)
fundorte.ort.ataturk_damm.warum: The country's largest dam; decides how much Euphrates water reaches Syria and Iraq.
fundorte.ort.ataturk_damm.wirkung: Leverage over Syria and Iraq (holding back or releasing water), power and irrigation in the south-east.
fundorte.ort.ilisu_damm.name: Ilısu Dam (Tigris)
fundorte.ort.ilisu_damm.wirkung: Water dispute with Iraq; power for the south-east.
fundorte.vorkommen.inland: Our own deposit: it reduces imports and makes the country more independent. The goods balance shows how self-sufficient it is.
fundorte.vorkommen.ausland: Deposit in {land}: using it takes good relations, pipelines or contracts.
fundorte.legende.vorkommen: Deposit of a raw material: colour as in the lens, large means world rank. Hover explains what it means.
fundorte.legende.eigen: Strategic place under Turkish control; hover shows why it matters.
